title: Design Input, Output, and Traceability Matrix

revisions.file: TMP1-QM.SLQ052/current/TMP1-QM.SLQ052 A Design Input, Output, and Traceability Matrix.docx
revisions.change_summary: Description of change: New traceability matrix (6 columns) replacing TMP1-QM.SLQ006, TMP2-QM.SLQ006, and TMP2-QM.SLQ007. Consolidates user needs, design inputs, design output references, V&V protocol references, status, and notes into one controlled document. Reason for change: IA-2025 OFI 2 (traceability of risk to design controls and V&V); IA-2025 mNC 1
